problem: BeBee needs an HTML5 save protocol that preserves the last valid generation across corrupt loads, failed writes/readbacks and migration failures while correctly representing Defold's delayed IndexedDB persistence semantics.

decision.rationale: Use two peer generation slots and always write the next generation to the missing/invalid/lower slot, then verify it by protected readback. This preserves the sole newest valid generation until the candidate is proven readable and avoids relying on an extra mutable active-slot pointer.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Current Defold sys documentation states that sys.get_save_file/sys.save/sys.load can raise errors, HTML5 save paths are in IndexedDB-backed storage, sys.save has a 512 KiB output ceiling and individual tables have a 65,536-row limit.
Defold currently documents pcall(sys.load, path) as the recoverable pattern for corrupt, foreign or unsupported serialized files.
Defold HTML5 uses an IndexedDB-backed virtual filesystem and documents a slight delay between file writes and persistent browser database storage.
Poki currently requires incognito playability and warns that local browser storage can be restricted.

Poki currently documents monitoring localStorage/IndexedDB for cloud gamesaves and a 1 MB gzip gamesave limit; BeBee does not assume the exact Defold IDBFS layout is cross-device synced until real-build verification.

alternatives.reason: A corrupt or failed overwrite can destroy the only usable save generation.
Can be safe with careful ordering, but backup/primary copy ordering is easier to implement incorrectly and can copy stale/corrupt state or overwrite the last-good file too early.

Both files are peers ordered by monotonic generation. New writes target the older/invalid slot and are verified by readback before success, preserving the previous valid generation without an active-pointer dependency.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The local storage contract never overwrites the sole newest valid generation before a candidate write is read back and validated.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: config/storage-contract.json local_adapter.write_rule/readback_verification_required and save_pipeline encode this invariant.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Corrupt/unsupported loads are protected and either generation slot can recover the game.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: config/storage-contract.json requires pcall and P0 test cases for A corrupt/B valid and B corrupt/A valid.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: HTML5 save success is not falsely labeled as immediate browser durability.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: durability.local_html5_default_after_success is accepted_local_pending_browser_persistence and the validator rejects stronger default claims.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Save growth stays far below the current Defold output ceiling.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 128 KiB warning and 256 KiB release gate are machine-readable and validated as warning < gate < 512 KiB ceiling.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Migration/write/readback failure paths preserve original valid state and are part of the required P0 test matrix.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: config/storage-contract.json includes required failed-write, failed-readback and migration-failure preservation tests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Portal cloud behavior does not become an unverified dependency of local persistence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Poki Defold-IDBFS cloud sync is explicitly MUST_VERIFY on a real portal build before cross-device behavior is relied upon.

automated: Static validator added at tools/storage/check_storage_contract.py and adversarial mutation tests added at tools/storage/test_storage_contract.py. Runtime execution belongs to P0 because the production Defold project/storage adapter does not exist yet.
manual: Cross-checked sys.save/sys.load/get_save_file, file-access pcall guidance, HTML5 IndexedDB persistence delay and current Poki incognito/cloud-gamesave documentation on 2026-08-28.
Replaced the older conceptual primary/backup flow in docs/12-platform-storage.md with the A/B generation protocol and explicit durability semantics.
verification.runtime_errors: none applicable; BB-P009 changes pre-runtime architecture/config/validation only
verification.save_data_impact: no existing production save exists; this contract defines the first public-format safety requirements for P0

known_limitations: No production Defold adapter exists yet, so crash/power-loss behavior is specified and must be proven in P0 browser tests.
Envelope checksum remains open until real corruption tests show value beyond sys.load errors plus schema/domain validation.
Poki cross-device handling of the exact Defold IndexedDB virtual filesystem remains a real-build verification gate.
